title: Level 2 (Intermediate) - D-15
notes:
West leads the ♠K against 5♦. South should ruff West's spade opening lead and plan to ruff his 2 heart losers in the dummy. If South can avoid losing a heart trick, he won't mind losing a trick to the ♦Q as South's only other loser will be in clubs.

South should cash the ♥A and ♥K at once, but if he ruffs a heart loser with the ♦10 he will be sorry on the above layout. East will overruff with the ♦Q and lead his remaining trump to take out dummy's ♦A. South will have no way of avoiding losers in both hearts and clubs and the contract will fail.

Once West follows to the third round of hearts, South should ruff his heart loser with dummy's ♦A to make sure that East cannot overruff with the ♦Q. After returning to the closed hand in clubs (or with a spade ruff), South ruffs his last heart loser with dummy's ♦10, not caring if East can overruff with the ♦Q. The defense can win a club trick, but South, with all high trumps, will win the balance of the tricks.
